{{Top|leg}}
'''Kokad''' was the term for an ancient warrior caste in [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] society on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Members of this cast were charged with defending homes from [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] creatures.

It was also a common name for Quarren [[Gender/Legends|males]], meaning "one who battles monsters".
